title: glmap 0.1.0
text: Initial release glmap: High-Performance GPU Geospatial Mapping sf terra R. Added C++17 GLMP (vector) GLMR (Float32 raster) binary encoders (gl_pack_sf_binary(), gl_pack_raster_binary()) mapbox/earcut.h polygon hole triangulation. Added WebGL2 + MapLibre GL JS rendering engine instanced SDF point shaders, polygon/line mesh shaders, additive Gaussian kernel heatmaps, 64-bit C++ hexagonal spatial binning (add_hexbin()), RGBA32F floating-point raster fragment shaders (add_raster()) 0 ms LUT palette switching, real-time surface-normal hillshading, multi-band math. Added gl_providers, add_provider_tiles(), gl_set_api_key(), gl_get_api_key() supporting CARTO, OpenFreeMap, OpenStreetMap, Esri, OpenTopoMap, USGS, MapTiler, Stadia, Thunderforest, Jawg, Mapbox. Added full leaflet superuser parity functions (add_circles(), add_rectangles(), add_popups(), add_labels(), add_wms_tiles(), show_group(), hide_group(), clear_group(), fly_to_bounds(), set_max_bounds()). Added glmap_proxy(), glmapOutput(), renderGlmap() leaflet-compatible Shiny events (_click, _bounds, _zoom, _center, _marker_click, _shape_click, _selected) crosstalk linked brushing. Added optional --core DuckDB / .parquet viewport streaming (add_duckdb()) C++17 spatial grid/R-tree indexing (gl_spatial_index()).
